name: Ambuscade
source:
It's your first day working at your favourite café. The job is simple: tend to your overenthusiastic customers, small talk your way through your shift with your socially awkward co-worker and endure your supervisors' obscure references.

And most importantly - mark your windowsill to check if your serial stalker intruded into your apartment last night.

[From [url=https://opheliacrias.itch.io/ambuscade]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是你在你最喜欢的咖啡馆工作的第一天。这项工作很简单：照顾过于热情的顾客，在轮班期间与不善社交的同事闲聊，并忍受主管的模糊参考。

最重要的是 - 在你的窗台上做标记，以检查你的连环跟踪者昨晚是否闯入你的公寓。

[来自[url=https://opheliacrias.itch.io/ambuscade]Itch.io[/url]]
